description: Stock management web app for Macroads. Replaces a hand-filled Excel workbook with yard-floor data entry, a live dashboard, and Excel as an export. Built as a Harness Engineering exercise: repo-as-system, leader/explorer/implementer/reviewer separation, spec-driven development.

features.name: repo_harness
features.title: Repository harness and spec foundation
features.description: Turn the directory into a system agents can work in: navigation map, docs, checkpoints, subagent definitions, progress log, verification entry point, and the two foundational specs.
acceptance: AC-1: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and CHECKPOINTS.md exist at the repository root
AC-2: docs/ contains architecture.md, conventions.md, verification.md and domain-glossary.md
AC-3: specs/ contains 000-product-brief.md and 001-domain-model.md, and 001 documents the workbook layout, the normalisation rules and the target schema
AC-4: .claude/agents/ contains leader.md, explorer.md, spec-writer.md, implementer.md and reviewer.md, each with valid YAML frontmatter
AC-6: init.ps1 and init.sh run to completion and print '[OK] Environment ready' with no application code present
AC-7: init verifies harness integrity: required files present, feature_list.json parses, every status and spec_status is valid, every spec_file referenced with spec_status != 'missing' exists on disk
AC-8: The repository is a git repository with an initial commit and a .gitignore covering node_modules, .env and build output
AC-9: Nothing under Samples/ has been modified

features.name: app_scaffold
features.title: Next.js application scaffold
features.description: Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind, Prisma against a Dockerised Postgres, Vitest and Playwright wired up, all invoked from init.

features.name: auth_and_roles
features.title: Accounts and role-based access
features.description: Auth.js credentials provider, User model, COUNTER/MANAGER/ADMIN roles, route protection, seeded first admin.

features.name: domain_schema
features.title: Domain schema and first migration
features.description: Prisma schema for Location, Supplier, ItemType, Item, ItemPrice, ItemLocation, StockCount, StockCountLine, plus the migration and model-level tests.

features.name: seed_from_workbook
features.title: Seed the item master from the source workbook
features.description: Idempotent importer reading Samples/*.xlsx into Suppliers, ItemTypes, Items, ItemPrices, ItemLocation and Vehicles, applying the normalisation rules in specs/001. Historical counts are NOT imported.
features.blocked_by_question: Q4 in specs/001-domain-model.md — items with no price

features.name: item_master_ui
features.title: Item master administration
features.description: CRUD for items, suppliers and types; versioned price lists; per-yard assignment and sheet ordering.

features.name: count_create
features.title: Start a stock count
features.description: Create a count for a location and date, pre-populated with that yard's active items in sheet order. One count per yard per day.

features.name: count_entry_ui
features.title: Count entry screen
features.description: Phone-first quantity entry with autosave, filtering by type and supplier, a running total, and carry-forward from the previous count.

features.name: count_submit
features.title: Submit and approve a count
features.description: DRAFT to SUBMITTED to APPROVED. Price snapshot written on submit. Approved counts immutable. Variance-against-last-count warnings before submit.

features.name: trucks_schema_seed
features.title: Trucks and yard-bulk schema
features.description: Vehicle, BoilerReading, BagReading and YardBulkReading models, plus seeding of the truck registrations and role labels from the workbook.
features.blocked_by_question: Q1 in specs/001-domain-model.md — does Dublin have trucks?

features.name: trucks_entry_ui
features.title: Truck and yard-bulk entry
features.description: Boiler percent-full and bag counts per truck, yard bulk bags, with kilogram rollups per material.
features.blocked_by_question: Q2 in specs/001-domain-model.md — do truck materials roll into the yard total?

features.name: dashboard_totals
features.title: Dashboard totals and variance
features.description: Total stock by yard, latest count date, month-on-month and year-on-year variance. The Summary sheet, computed live.

features.name: dashboard_breakdown
features.title: Dashboard breakdowns
features.description: Value by type and by supplier, biggest movers since the last count, per-item quantity trend.

features.name: export_yard_sheet
features.title: Excel export: yard sheets
features.description: Per-location sheet reproducing the Qty|Value column-pair layout with real headers and styling, generated from approved counts.

features.name: export_summary_sheet
features.title: Excel export: summary sheet
features.description: Summary sheet with per-yard totals, total stock, MoM and YoY variance, generated from count totals and free of formula errors.

features.name: export_trucks_and_blank
features.title: Excel export: trucks sheet and printable blank count sheet
features.description: Trucks and yard sheet, plus a printable blank count sheet as a paper fallback for the yard.

features.name: deploy
features.title: Production deployment
features.description: Neon Postgres plus Vercel, environment configuration, migrate deploy in the pipeline, documented backup and restore.
